title: fix(plugin-charts): refuse a series key no row carries, naming the column (objectui#10396)
body:
Fixes #10396
Clause-②: no

## What changed

A bar / column / horizontal-bar / line / area / combo tile whose EVERY bound series key names a column no row carries drew the category ticks and zero marks, and said nothing (the objectui#8266 shape). It now renders the existing `ChartRefusal` placeholder (`role="status"`, `data-chart-error`) with a new code, `missing-series-key`, and a sentence worded after `missing-category-key`:

> This chart cannot plot its series: no row has a `value` field.

Several missing keys are joined with "or". Like `missing-category-key`, a console warning names the missing keys and the keys the rows DO carry (for a fieldless count that second half is `count`, which is the remedy). Direction: triage option B (comment `5825175572`), unlock `5852964249`.

- `hasNoCarriedSeriesKey` in `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` asks `key in row`, the category guard's own test, over every row and every bound series; only for `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES`. Only a plain key (no `.` and no `[`) is judged, because Recharts reads a series through es-toolkit's `compat/get`, which returns `row[key]` for such a key and walks a path otherwise. A path-shaped key therefore keeps the tile silent.
- The new warning effect depends on two JSON strings, not on an array or memo identity (AGENTS.md #10).
- The `hasNoNumericSeriesValue` doc paragraph that said the absent-key shape waits for its own decision now points at the new guard. Its predicate is unchanged.
- The two render pins are re-decided on purpose (see below). New file `AdvancedChartImpl.missingSeriesKey.test.tsx`.
- Changeset `.changeset/10396-missing-series-key-refusal.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts: patch`). A dated note is appended to `.changeset/7195-no-numeric-value-refusal.md` in the objectui#10533 form, frontmatter byte-identical (md5 of its first three lines equal at base and head). Its sentence "(... or a column no row carries) keeps the chart silent" is made false by this change when every bound key is such a column.

## H1: reproduced on the base

Base `17cc3a377`, the package's fixed 480x320 harness, rows `[{k:'a',count:2},{k:'b',count:5}]`, one series bound to `value`: bar, column, horizontal-bar, line, area and combo each drew **0 marks with no `data-chart-error`**. They also drew 0 marks, silently, with a stack, a declared `min` + `max`, a `min` + `stepSize`, or a second axis. Lit control: the same rows bound to `count` draw (bar / column / horizontal-bar / combo 2 rectangles, line / area one path).

Before/after probe, base vs head, 108 tiles (6 families x 17 shapes, plus scatter / pie / donut / funnel / treemap / radar): drew on base 34, **drawn tiles changed 0**, refusal changed 36, and each of those 36 is a 0-mark tile on base that now reads `missing-series-key`.

## H2: placement and precedence

Order in the outer wrapper: `missing-category-key`, then `no-plottable-series`, then `missing-series-key`, then `no-numeric-value`.

- **Category key AND series key both absent: `missing-category-key` wins.** A chart with no category axis is the more fundamental failure, and the existing guards already rank it first. The objectui#8269 pin's `name` / `value` case already asserted this (unchanged, now commented as the precedence pin), and the new file pins it again.
- `no-plottable-series` owns "no series at all", so it comes first. The new guard needs a bound series to name.
- Before `no-numeric-value`: an absent column is a binding diagnosis, a present column with no scalable value is a scale diagnosis. The two are disjoint by construction (`no-numeric-value` stays silent unless every key is some row's own property), and the new result also gates it.
- **Partial series sets, measured on the base and followed.** The family refuses a whole tile only when nothing can draw: `no-numeric-value` keys on ALL series and declines a dual-axis tile with one dead axis, and `missing-category-key` fires only when not one row carries the key. So one row carrying the key draws (bar 1 rectangle), an absent key beside a carried one draws the carried series (bar 2 rectangles), and only every-key-absent refuses.

## H3: text and i18n

`missing-category-key`'s sentence is a JSX English literal, and so are both `no-plottable-series` sentences and `no-numeric-value`. None goes through a locale key, so the new sentence is a literal too and `packages/i18n` is untouched. The `check:i18n-*` gates read `t()` call sites and locale packs, and this diff touches neither.

## Pins and ablation

- **Red on base.** The three test files (new file 46 tests, the objectui#8266 pin 3, the objectui#8269 pin 8) run against the base `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (blob `56d0ff1e`, restored to HEAD blob `ea7bf84d`, `git diff HEAD` empty): **16 failed / 41 passed of 57**. The 16 are exactly the refusal assertions: the six families' refusal, every-key-absent, the warning, the six "whatever else it declares" cases, the objectui#8266 `value` arm and the objectui#8269 `status/value` case. Every draw control and seam test was green on base.
- **Green on head.** The package run below, at `423704076`.
- **Ablation.** `hasNoCarriedSeriesKey(props);` replaced by `null; /* ABLATION-10396 */` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `ea7bf84d` to `0f0f82ef`), over those three files plus `AdvancedChartImpl.noNumericValue.test.tsx`: **16 failed / 240 passed of 256**, the same 16, and the `no-numeric-value` file stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build step is involved: the tests import `./AdvancedChartImpl` from source, and `ChartRenderer` lazy-imports the same relative specifier.
- **The two pins.** `ObjectChart.countSeriesKeyRender-8266.test.tsx` gains a header section "Re-decided on purpose by objectui#10396: the zero arm now REFUSES", and its `value` arm now asserts 0 marks, `missing-series-key` and "no row has a value field". `ObjectChart.categoryAxisKeyRender-8269.test.tsx` gains "Re-decided on purpose by objectui#10396: the FIRST row now refuses"; its `status/value` case asserts the new refusal and that the text does not name `status`. The baseline table is kept as history. Neither pin was deleted.

- Each exit 0: `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (it reports the 7195 dated note, its case 2), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-shell-escape-residue`.
- `check-changeset-claims` names `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md` because it names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`. Read: `stack` still becomes `stackId` and `yAxis` still binds the secondary axis, so it is still true.
- Lint, narrowed and declared: `eslint --format json` over the four touched files from the package directory (the package `lint` script is `eslint .` on the same config). 4 files, **0 errors**, 58 warnings. Warnings on the three edited files equal their base counts (44 / 3 / 5); the new file's 6 are `no-explicit-any` in the test harness, as in its siblings. The resolved config's `parserOptions` is empty (no type-aware linting), so this diff cannot change the verdict for a file it did not touch. The full `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- Consumer sweep not run locally (the dispatch order asks for no wider sweeps). `data-chart-error` is read inside `packages/plugin-charts` only (19 files; 0 in any other package, app or example). CI's full `pnpm test` covers the consumers.

## Serial

No open PR touched `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` at claim time (13:45Z). `git merge-tree --write-tree` against a fresh `origin/main` (`bf14b6460`) is clean, and `origin/main` has not changed `packages/plugin-charts` or the 7195 changeset since the base.

## Acceptance notes

- **An absent key beside a present-but-dead key still draws nothing, silently, as on the base.** Example: `value` (no row) beside an all-boolean `w`. Neither refusal fires: `no-numeric-value`'s resolved-key gate stays silent over an absent key (unchanged, per the triage's third point), and the new guard needs every key absent. Pinned as measured and left. Covering it would mean reading the objectui#7195 liveness predicate from the new guard.
- A path-shaped key such as `a.b` that resolves nothing stays silent (0 marks). This is by design: the guard does not re-implement Recharts' path grammar, so a path is never judged absent.
- `AdvancedChartImpl.noNumericValue.test.tsx` still has a test name and comment written before this decision ("left to its own question", "keep it silent until it is re-decided"). The file is outside the claimed surface and was not edited. The test still passes, because it asserts only that `no-numeric-value` does not fire.
- `.changeset/4695-no-series-binding-refusal.md` says "Unchanged: ... every chart that declares its series". Read as a statement about that change's own scope, it stays true, so it was not reconciled.
- The two older warning effects in the same wrapper depend on `firstRowKeys`, a `useMemo` result (AGENTS.md #10). The new effect does not. Observation only.
- Radar is outside `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES`. It never receives this code (pinned). Whether radar draws an absent key was not measured: the harness mark counter does not count radar polygons.

Card relations are declared here only; the commit carries no card trailer. Implemented by `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), `mode:subagent` under the `domain:ui#2` seat.


- **Seat edit at landing (contract review on this PR).** H3's sibling list names the four English-literal siblings. For completeness: of this file's refusals, only `scatter-multi-series` resolves through a locale key (`chart.scatterOneMeasure`); `missing-series-key` follows the English-literal majority it mirrors (`missing-category-key`). The `MissingSeriesKeyRefusal` doc comment's "matching every sibling sentence" is loose for that reason. It is recorded here and not pushed for.
- **Seat ruling on the open question:** A, the absent-beside-dead-key case stays silent in this PR (card objectui#10396, ruling comment).
